scope: Independent read-only review of every actual foreground picture against exact Swedish and reviewed Russian source pairs, conditions and advisory logic; no export/audio review.
positive_findings: Exact SV source passages reconstruct correctly and all source archive hashes match.
Reviewed Russian qualifiers, alternatives and application/grant wording were compared with the Swedish and no new translation mismatch was found.
The corrected actual warning/document glyphs avoid treating violence/exploitation as approved conduct or a person as prohibited.
No invented qualifying residence period, permit expiry date, work-hour number, personal identifier or applicant/victim status photograph was introduced.

findings.finding: The last node is a check-shield reached by arrows, labelled nytt uppehållstillstånd. The source requires applying for a new permit on the changed basis, and does not promise grant.
findings.suggestion: Use an application/document object and a source-exact ansöka label or qualifier for the destination; retain the A- eller B-tillstånd gate.

findings.finding: The two-year revocation alternative lacks utomlands on the picture: middle label is minst två år, while the bar repeats kontinuerligt i minst två år. The source explicitly requires continuously abroad.
findings.suggestion: Change the middle node label to utomlands, keeping the existing continuous-at-least-two-years condition bar. Keep the three reasons alternatives, not cumulative requirements.

findings.finding: bokstavskoden P is attached across the continuous-permit/calendar/permanent-permit sequence. A/B code labels in picture005 are correctly scoped to their own documents.
findings.suggestion: Attach P only to the permanent-permit endpoint (node2) to avoid visually applying P to the preceding continuous permit.

findings.finding: The picture labels generic move-to-Finland -> continuous permit and shows only Utgångspunkten above it. The permanent-intent condition is present in exact bilingual body text but absent from the picture.
findings.suggestion: If refining, attach source-exact betraktas som permanent to the move node rather than implying every move normally produces continuous status.

limits: Root owns all episode/media mutations; no root-owned files changed.
Not a fresh legal fact check or approval of current immigration requirements.
Final timed stills, exported frame/decode/mix, whole-video listening and user acceptance remain separate.

resolution_recheck.scope: Only the five root-regenerated pictures rechecked at full native size; all listed substantive/low-priority findings resolved.
